analyzer.scope: All changed Dart source and test files against baseline; informational lints are not claimed to be eliminated.

focused: page stream race:|stream efficiency:|worker recovery:|admin connection progress:|worker sync optimization:|admin paging |worker colour
comparable_main: ^(?!worker intake shows and expands only pending assigned material: refresh failure$).*

verified_behaviors: Healthy readOnly, supply, qolip and material streams perform no repeated HTTP reads; pause stops background work and negotiated resume preserves the cursor.
Worker cursor recovery avoids duplicate bootstrap; failure, timeout and permission paths retain bounded recovery and fail closed.
Paged color updates and checkpoints require no HTTP prefix refresh; unchanged Material card instances are reused.
Out-of-order/malformed/base-version/epoch page patches are rejected atomically.
A delayed page delta cannot certify an older queue revision after a local reorder acknowledgement.
An old short subscription cannot erase a prefix just extended through HTTP.
Two move panes with different revisions block both current and retained action callbacks; matching checkpoints restore authority without HTTP.
Old global state-ready messages without recovery capability fall back to the legacy full stream and polling.
Notifications share one physical socket, release it when the last listener cancels, and do not replay/open a stale-account stream.
Account changes during asynchronous live setup open no cross-account socket; stale HTTP does not overwrite newer notifications.
limitations: Focused tests overlap with the main library and must not be added to its totals as unique tests.
The protocol baseline rerun covers the three files containing all six failures, not every current protocol test file.
No claim is made that the entire repository test suite is green.
Widget assertions establish HTTP/rebuild behavior, not device FPS or battery measurements; server load measurements are documented separately.
